# pstack

The principles, the Comment Sicko agent and the Claude Code adapter of pstack, from https://github.com/cursor/plugins (folder
`harness/pstack/claude-code`, commit `e58dd043600587dbaf58ba315e7f2b38373eeb43`), by Lauren Tan (poteto), under the MIT license (see LICENSE in this
folder). Copied unmodified by scripts/vendor-pstack.sh. optimia adds the principles that fit each of
its agents to that agent's prompt, and the Comment Sicko text to the comments stage. The pstack
skills it bundles are in vendor/skills, each with its own SOURCE.md.
